pages.text: The Life Synthesis Vat is a single-placement $(bold)3×3×2$() machine: it grows tissue from organic culture media and a nutrient fluid, then distills it into Life Fluid. It is the late-game, mob-free Life Fluid production line.$(br2)$(bold)Quick Start$()

1. Clear a complete 3×3×2 area and place the machine. 2. The controller with the front viewport opens the main screen: insert culture media (wheat, carrots, meat, eggs, golden apples) and supply Water and FE. 3. When the culture progress fills up, batches are distilled automatically: direct neighbors with fluid capability get priority, the rest goes into the internal Life Fluid tank. 4. Attach pipes to any controller face or configure Auto I/O in the screen.$(br2)$(bold)Recipe Tiers$()

| Tier | Culture media examples | Per batch | Nutrient | Time | Energy | |------|------------------------|-----------|----------|------|--------| | Plant | Wheat, beetroot, carrot, potato, melon slice, saplings, flowers, pumpkin/melon | 8 items (2 for pumpkin/melon) → 250 mB | 1000 mB Water | 200 ticks | 2000 FE | | Protein | Raw/cooked meat, eggs, fish, milk bucket, honey bottle | 4 items (1 for milk/honey) → 500 mB | 1000 mB Water | 400 ticks | 5000 FE | | Enriched | Golden apple, enchanted golden apple, nether star, wither skeleton skull, boss essences | 1 item → 1250 mB | 1000 mB Water | 800 ticks | 12000 FE |

$(li)Every batch consumes 1000 mB of Water (or the recipe's nutrient fluid).$(li)While Time Fluid is available, each batch drains an extra 100 mB (configurable) and culture speed doubles.$(li)Life Fluid and Life Apple items can never be used as media, preventing feedback loops.$(br2)$(bold)Core Values$()

| Property | Value | |----------|-------| | Speed | 1-32x; Overclock or Creative locks it to 64x; Time Fluid boost doubles it again | | Energy capacity | 20,000,000 FE (configurable) | | Fluid tanks | Nutrient / Time / Life, 64,000 mB each by default (configurable) | | Pending (undistilled) queue | Up to 262,144 mB (configurable); production stops when full | | Settlement | Batched every 20 ticks, up to 1,024 batches per settlement |$(br2)Progress is only reset when the recipe disappears (media swapped out or nutrient type no longer matches); missing FE, water, or Time Fluid only pauses production and never loses progress.$(br2)$(bold)Upgrades$()

$(li)Supported: Capacity, Fluid, Overclock, Creative.$(li)Not supported: Range, Filter, Underclock, Precision, Fortune.$(li)Creative removes FE and Time Fluid costs, but media and nutrient are still consumed.$(br2)$(bold)Output Strategy$()$(br2)Distillation fills adjacent fluid handlers on the 3×3×2 boundary in "most recently successful neighbor first" order; whatever cannot be exported goes into the internal Life Fluid tank, which pipes or Auto I/O can extract.$(br2)$(bold)Placement and Removal$()

The controller sits at the front center of the base layer; the other 17 blocks are stateless structure parts. Right-click any part to open the controller; breaking any part tears down the whole structure and drops a single Life Synthesis Vat item. Legacy 3×3×3 structures automatically remove their third layer after loading.$(br2)$(bold)Crafting$()
